name: 'US$' in a Portuguese sentence is a currency, not the United States
query: financiamento de caminhao de US 3 milhoes no Brasil
note: Incident (fixed 2026-09-08): the bare ' us ' token in 'US 3 milhoes no Brasil' matched the United States geography. That is worse than a missed filter — it made a Brazilian deal look domestic, disarmed intl_required (so Domestic-only lenders stopped being excluded) and put US-only funders at the top of a Brazil shortlist while the Brazilian ones were pushed down. Asserts the geography is Brazil, is NOT the United States, and that the international requirement is armed. Guards src/lib/search/extract-deal.ts ('United States' patterns) alongside src/lib/search/query-robustness.test.ts.
